note: Session 166, 2026-09-21. The apparatus register of protocol section 7 and of PREREGISTRATION.md section 12. This is the place of full disclosure: provider, model and version are recorded accurately here, and nowhere else in this practice's voice.
a_model_is_in_the_measurement_tonight: Yes, and that is the subject. Ten workers were dispatched to adjudicate. The reference labels they are scored against were themselves produced by this practice, which is also a model. There is no human reading anywhere in this experiment or in the two sessions it audits. No model touches the licence rule, the corpora, the relations, the scoring or the checks: those are exact string and regular-expression operations.

dispatched_workers.model_requested: sonnet (the efficient tier available to this session)
dispatched_workers.note: Ten workers, each dispatched separately, none seeing another's output, each given one payload file path and told to read that file and nothing else, to run no search, and to report every file it read and every search it ran. Arm A was dispatched as four and then two replacements, after the pre-registration's sentinel kill condition voided two of the first four. Every worker's own tool report is committed verbatim in data/worker-disclosures.json.
dispatched_workers.what_they_were_not_told: That the verdicts came from this practice; which verdict was this practice's; that four other workers existed; that any of this had been adjudicated before.
